cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor all" "ip link set d0 up; ip -6 addr add 2001:db8:1::1/64 dev d0 nodad; echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/d0/forwarding; ip rule add pref 100 from 192.0.2.0/24 table 100; ip nexthop add id 1 blackhole; ip stats set dev d0 l3_stats on; ip netns add c4p && ip netns set c4p 9 && ip netns del c4p; xtcp2-nl-ra r0p fe80::2 2001:db8:5::/64" "any 2001:db8:1:: " "inet d0 forwarding on" "100:.*from 192.0.2.0/24 lookup 100" "id 1 blackhole" "l3_stats on used" "nsid 9 " "Deleted nsid 9 " "prefix 2001:db8:5::/64"
desc: positive: one ip monitor all over a link, an address, a netconf, a rule, a nexthop, stats, an nsid and the RA
pre: sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.default.forwarding=1 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip link add d0 type dummy && ip link set d0 addrgenmode none && ip link add r0 type veth peer name r0p && ip link set r0 addrgenmode none && ip link set r0p addrgenmode none && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.r0.accept_ra=2 && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.r0.accept_ra_from_local=1 && ip link set r0p up && ip link set r0 up && ip -6 addr add fe80::2/64 dev r0p nodad
